description: Lists every FAA Airman Certification Standard (ACS) in Aviation Resources, such as Private Pilot - Airplane or Instrument Rating - Airplane, with its ID, whether it is ready for use, and how many areas of operation and tasks it has. Use this first to find the ACS a lesson is for.
name: list_airman_certification_standards

id.description: UUID of the ACS. Pass it to airman_certification_standards to get its areas of operation, tasks, elements and sub-elements.

name.description: Name of the ACS, e.g. "Private Pilot - Airplane".

ready.description: True when the ACS has been fully entered and reviewed. Prefer ready standards.

title: List Airman Certification Standards
